lines.text: I spent good money on a knob.
They said it was made for vibe coding.
Turns out its driver can do exactly one thing:
pretend to be a few keys on a keyboard.
So why not just press the keyboard?
So I gave it a new soul.
One wand, to command them all.
When you vibe code, you barely type.
You read. You wait. You switch. And now and then, you say a sentence.
All of that takes one hand.
Turn it, to read the reply.
Hold, and speak.
Let go. The words are in the box.
Press once to switch chats. Hold, to switch models.
Lean back. The work goes on.
But the tools keep multiplying. Codex. Claude. DeepSeek Harness. Claude Code in a terminal. Browsers. WeChat. Feishu.
And every one has its own set of shortcuts.
VibeWand replaces none of them. It puts them all behind the same few motions.
One wand, for all of them.
Then I thought: it already listens to me talk. Why not let it take orders?
Behind it is an agent that runs on DeepSeek Harness. The model is yours to choose.
By default it takes no screenshots. It reads the structure of the interface, as the system describes it. And before it sends or deletes anything, it asks you.
VibeWand. Your word is its command.
And there is more than one wand.
The VibeKey dial. A PS5 controller, microphone included. A Xiaomi remote. Or just the keyboard on your desk.
Use whatever you have.
VibeWand. Still in development. Come and play.
Oh, and this video? I said a few sentences, and Claude Code made it.
Fix the error on the login page, and add the unit tests while you are at it.
Put on some music for coding.
New Keynote deck. Title it: One wand to command them all.
